_comment: Manually maintained fallback for the weekly projects routine. This session's GitHub access is repository-scoped and cannot list FethiOmur's repos account-wide (api.github.com/users/FethiOmur/repos and /search/repositories both return 403 regardless of what's in scope). As a workaround, the routine checks each repo below individually via the repo-scoped endpoint (api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}), which works IF that repo has been added to this session's/trigger's GitHub repository access list. Add a new entry here whenever a new public project repo is created, and add that same repo to the session's repository access list (Claude Code on the web -> this scheduled task's environment/trigger settings -> repository access) at the same time -- this file alone does not grant access.
